answer: Every request uses a fresh one-time key derived from the session key and the request number, and the key is never reused. A captured request cannot be replayed, because its one-time key is already spent, and the server rejects any request whose key has been seen before. A vertex that appears twice is the tell: the same session cannot live twice. From the voyage to the ivory, the same rule holds: no continuity, no trust, no exception.
